source: Pew Research Center. 2014. "Religion in Latin America: Widespread Change in a Historically Catholic Region."
method: Population is Brazil respondents only (Country=Brazil). Share answering "yes" to each of Q63a/Q63b/Q63d/Q63e/Q63f ("Do you personally consider [group] to be followers of the Christian faith, or not?"); don't know/refused excluded, "never heard of group" retained as a valid non-yes response. Weighted by the dataset's own combined base/post-stratification WEIGHT.
